skills.name: using-raps-mcp
skills.description: Use when calling any RAPS MCP tool, working with Autodesk Platform Services APIs, or setting up RAPS MCP for the first time — covers batch tool fetching, domain groupings, and common parameter patterns.

skills.name: adding-mcp-tool
skills.description: Use when adding a new MCP tool to the RAPS MCP server — covers tool schema definition, handler implementation, dispatch registration, and the client accessor pattern.

skills.name: adding-raps-cli-command
skills.description: Use when adding a new CLI command or subcommand to RAPS — covers the clap struct pattern, module wiring, output formatting, and test structure across the 10-crate workspace.

skills.name: composing-raps-linkedin-posts
skills.description: Use when new RAPS features ship and LinkedIn content is needed — adds posts to the raps-smm post bank following established tone, format, and hashtag conventions.

skills.name: cutting-raps-release
skills.description: Use when bumping the RAPS version for a new release — updates Cargo.toml workspace version, 9 internal crate dependencies, 6 npm package.json files, creates git tag, and triggers the release workflow.

skills.name: raps-ci-cd-templates
skills.description: Use when adding or updating CI/CD integrations in the raps-actions repo — GitHub Actions composite actions, GitLab CI include templates, test workflows, and floating tag management.

skills.name: raps-security-audit
skills.description: Use before releases or after dependency updates to run security checks — cargo-audit, ASVS compliance matrix review, clippy security lints, redaction pattern verification.

skills.name: shorten-url
skills.description: Use when you need to create a shortened URL at go.rapscli.xyz — for long Cloudflare OAuth links, wrangler login URLs, or any URL that's unwieldy in the terminal.

skills.name: updating-devcon-materials
skills.description: Use when DevCon 2026 session content needs updating — covers the 3 session files in raps-marketing, LinkedIn countdown posts in raps-smm, and forum announcements. DevCon is April 15-16 in Amsterdam.

skills.name: updating-raps-marketing
skills.description: Use when new RAPS features or releases need reflecting in raps-marketing — press releases, campaign updates, DevCon session content, feature lists.

skills.name: updating-raps-website
skills.description: Use when a new RAPS version is released or a major feature ships and the raps-website repo needs updating — release entries, docs pages, blog posts, stats.

skills.name: verifying-raps-release
skills.description: Use after a RAPS release workflow completes to verify all distribution channels — GitHub release assets, npm packages, PyPI, install script, and binary functionality.

skills.name: writing-cookbook-recipe
skills.description: Use when writing a new cookbook recipe for the RAPS website — covers the MDX frontmatter format, section structure, category taxonomy, and Tailwind styling patterns for workflow visualizations.

skills.name: writing-raps-blog-post
skills.description: Use when writing a technical blog post for the RAPS website — covers MDX frontmatter, Astro component imports, series linking, i18n stub creation, and common escaping pitfalls.
